text: Mobilize L/B with 225k HWO to SS119-W platform. Pull 2-7/8" tubing and 7-5/8" Baker FH Production Packer.  Complete L21 Sand with sand control. Install new 2-7/8" production string with gas lift. Operations took place 7/3/2021 - 7/24/2021.

Leed Petroleum LLC has successfully completed operations on the EI 183 A4 to add perforations to the existing "Tex X-2" Sand completion.
Perfs were added from 13654' - 13660' MD.

Operations began on 05-02-10 and were completed on 05-04-10.

Intitial APM was to replace dummy valves with live gas lift valves.  A subsequent RPM was submitted to fish stuck tools that were lost in the hole while attempting to pull the standing valve once the gas lift valve work was complete.

Operations on ST 81, OCS-G-27155, Well A-1 to restore production from the existing "O" Sand perforations, 19268' - 19358' MD were completed, but proved unsuccessful.  Coil tubing was used to pump a scale treatment into the formation, which allowed the fish located @ 19212' MD to fall downhole and re-expose the "O" Sand perfs to production.  However, the A-1 well only produced water and is currently shut-in.  Operations began on January 19, 2010 and ended on January 23, 2010.

Utilize coil tubing to temporarily abandon the Lower CIB Carst zone to place a cement plug across the perforations.
Temporary abandonment operations of the wellbore will be completed with a platform rig at a later date.

Well was spud on March 11, 2013 and TD reached on March 29, 2013 with a depth of 11,194' MD/10,950' TD.  Well was completed as a single, gravel packed oil completion  in the B-22 and completed as a single, gravel packed alternate completion in B-23 Sand. Operations were completed on May 13, 2013.

The Europa EA05 ST01BP00 MC0935 OCS-G 07976 well will be a development production well, targeting the depleted I1 sand drilled by the Stena Evolution.
The well is directional, with an existing surface hole location being in MC934 and bottom hole location in MC935.

After several failed attempts to retrieve EAS packoff assembly a decision was made to discontinue the proposed operation; wellbore configuration remains the same.

Discontinued Operations on 06/11/2016.

Unsuccessful Zone Change

After multiple unsuccessful attempts to get a good test on the tubing, we suspend operations until a plan forward can be assessed. The standing valve and isolation mandrel will remain in the well until operations can be continued.

K-2 well had been shut-in since 1996 as a gravel pack completion in the T(P) 16A sand w/perforations @ 11,146'-11,228'. It has had problems with sand in tubing and holes in tubing causing tubing-casing communication. Attempts to RTP were impeded by a standing valve stuck in the tubing above the completion. 

EPL performed a tubing swap and regravel packed the existing Tex(P) 16 RA completion.

Temporary Abandonment
Mark the WBS is noted as a TA schematic. The casing were cut but will not be removed until the platform is removed at which time we will submit a request to remove the casings and classify the well as PAed.

Stone Energy has sucessfully isolated the J Lower sand perforations with a 59' cement cap on top of a bridge plug set at 8099'MD. The J Upper Sand was perforated for production from 8008'-8028'MD at 12 spf & 7994'-8007'MD at 6 spf. Operations were concluded prior to setting of screens & gravel packing due to pulling out of rope socket, creating the rope socket/perforation assembly fish. Well was attempted to flow without gravel packing and sand production was noted, top of sand fill at 7980'MD. Attempts to loosen & bail sand were unsuccessful. Operations are stopped pending evaluation for future coil tubing operations. Well is shut in.

Operations to finish temporary abandonment through the surface plug were completed on 11/02/2019.  Zonal isolation was previously completed as of 03/26/2012 thus eWell recognizes that as the well's temporary abandonment date.

Due to the fact that this well was previously classified as PA?d by a previous operator in 1974 McMoRan is not aware of the dates the cement plugs were placed on this well.  This well was actually PA?d by McMoRan on 05/19/2012 all casings cut @ 20-ft BML.

Coiled tubing zone change Operations were successfully completed on the EI 28 Well #006 to produce the "Upper Cib-Carst" Sand. The "Lower Cib-Carst" Sand was isolated setting a MRBP at 10,656' MD w/ 20' of cmt dump bailed on top of the plug; ETOC at 10,636 MD. Bridge plug & cmt plug were pressure tested to 3500 psi. A peddle basket was set at 10,520' MD w/ 17' cmt dump bailed on top of basket; ETOC at 10,503' MD. The "Upper Cib-Carst" Sand was exposed to production by perforating intervals 10,478'-10,490' MD/TVD. Operations started 06/03/2013 and ended 06/14/2013.

Due to the fact that this well was classified as P&A?d by a previous operator in 1983 when the well was actually TA?d, McMoRan cannot change the P&A date to truly reflect the correct P&A date.  The B003 well was actually P&A?d (all casings removed 16-ft BML) on 08/05/2010.

Temporarily Abandoned.
Note:  20" DP x 10-3/4" casing will be removed when platform is removed.  A new APM will be submitted.  Also, please update the database to show that ST01 was a slot recovery (no KOP); and the KOP for ST02 was at 4112' md.

Stone has successfully completed zone change operations on the Mississippi Canyon Block 265,OCS-G 18208, Well A15ST2 to produce the "LG" Sand.  Operations with the MODU, Rowan Alaska began on 05-26-08 and were completed 06-11-08.  The well is producing as a single non-gravel packed, gas completion in the "LG" with perforations of 15988' - 16028' & 16036' - 16046' MD.

After isolating the HG C Sand, EXXI discontinued proposed operations due to both the Long String & Short String being damaged. A DX plug was set in the long string, pumped kill weight fluid in well and the FXE was reset in short string.
